chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Husayn ibn Nu'aym al-Sahhaf, who said:
I asked Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام about His saying:
So among you is a disbeliever, and among you is a believer.

So he عليه السلام said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, knew their faith through their wilayah toward us, and their disbelief through it, on the day He took the covenant from them while they were particles in the loins of Adam.
And I asked him about the saying of the Mighty and Majestic:
Obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away, then only the clear delivery rests upon Our Messenger.

So he عليه السلام said: Indeed, by Allah, those before you were not destroyed, and none who are destroyed until our Qa'im عليه السلام rises will be destroyed except through abandoning our wilayah and denying our right. And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله did not depart from this world until he bound the necks of this community to our right.
And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.

key_terms.إِيمَانَهُمْ: their faith, identified here through acceptance of wilayah
key_terms.الْمِيثَاقَ: the covenant taken by Allah from creation
key_terms.بِمُوَالَاتِنَا: through loyalty and devotion to us, meaning the wilayah of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.حَقِّنَا: our right, the rightful claim and due of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.ذَرٌّ: minute particles, referring to the pre-earthly state of humanity
key_terms.صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ: a straight path, the path of true guidance
key_terms.قَائِمُنَا: our Qa'im, the one who will rise from among them
key_terms.وَلَايَتِنَا: our wilayah, the divinely ordained authority and allegiance due to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: How do these Qur'anic verses relate to wilayah and the right of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the cited Qur'anic verses through the lens of wilayah, stating that faith and disbelief were known by Allah through acceptance or rejection of the Ahl al-Bayt's authority from the primordial covenant. It further teaches that destruction comes through abandoning their wilayah and denying their right, while guidance remains in Allah's hand toward the straight path.
